en:
-A deck must contain 50 cards.
-You may include up to 4 copies of any card with the same name in your deck.
-Shuffle your deck and place it in your Deck Area.
-Draw 5 cards as your starting hand.
-You may mulligan once by placing your hand to the bottom of your deck, then draw 5 new cards. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
-Place the top 4 cards of your deck face-down into your Guardian Area.
-Each player start with 500 Tamer Points.

key: -At the start of your turn, draw 1 card. -You may play Tetramon card by placing it into one of the Elemental Areas. -When a card is played, its Play Effect will be triggered. -An Evolution Card may only be played by placing it on top of the Tetramon it evolves from. -Basic Tetramon cannot evolve on the turn it is played. -You can evolve as many times as you like during your turn. -You may only play Basic Card in the same Elemental Area once per turn. -When playing a Basic Card, discard any cards currently on that Elemental Area before placing the new card.
en:
-At the start of your turn, draw 1 card.
-You may play Tetramon card by placing it into one of the Elemental Areas.
-When a card is played, its Play Effect will be triggered. 
-An Evolution Card may only be played by placing it on top of the Tetramon it evolves from.
-Basic Tetramon cannot evolve on the turn it is played.
-You can evolve as many times as you like during your turn.
-You may only play Basic Card in the same Elemental Area once per turn.
-When playing a Basic Card, discard any cards currently on that Elemental Area before placing the new card.
